data.one_liner: Fetch the unique identifier (ANDROID_ID or identifierForVendor) from Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that allows developers to fetch the unique device identifier. It retrieves the ANDROID_ID on Android and identifierForVendor on iOS.
use_when: You need to retrieve the unique device identifier for analytics or tracking purposes.
Your app targets both Android and iOS platforms.
avoid_when: You need detailed device hardware information beyond a single unique string identifier.
You need a general device info package that provides SDK versions, models, and manufacturer details.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for fetching a unique device ID.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
weaknesses: Very limited functionality compared to broader device info packages.
Behavior of unique identifiers can change across Android versions, factory resets, or reinstalls.
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions or complex setup documented beyond standard plugin installation.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides comprehensive device information including unique identifiers along with OS version, hardware details, and platform specifics.
